text:
Hi — I'm Jordan, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. It's good to meet you.

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA at https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; after that you have chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **Messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX (and my own Messenger and Instagram), so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want any of those?
- **Website accounts** — I can register and sign in on services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- **Also** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.
